semantics.default_class_field_binding: val for all primitive, nominal and generic type arguments; no implicit mut
semantics.explicit_rebinding: let; requires authorized receiver or mutable loan
semantics.referent_mutation: mut requests independently checked referent-write authority, never implicit name rebinding
semantics.val: binding fixed, runtime initializer permitted within supported effect profile
semantics.final: exactly one initialization; deferred assignment only with definite-assignment proof
semantics.const: compile-time-evaluable class field; no file/module runtime os.read_env exception
semantics.legacy_named_fields: keep existing semantics pending separate migration
semantics.locals: type-first local shorthand retains const, not implicit val
semantics.package_access: private class-only; pub[pkg] authenticated declaring package only; pub exposed if declaring type accessible
semantics.negative_fixture_rule: Must fail before artifact emission with expected compiler error

provenance_policy: A successful source-free CI probe, parser-only acceptance or host-only test is not compiled guest conformance. Pin source SHA/tree/blob hashes and record executed guest returns or compile diagnostics. Cross-package security requires a real multi-package compiler and cannot be established by these same-file fixtures.
